The header's 6.6.6.6. Ref. gives the stanzas' metre only, so no metre fixes the refrain's lines. join:refrain.1.3: p179-strip1600.jpg system 4, the refrain's row: line 4's first word is a pronoun for Christ, printed with a capital as such pronouns are mid-line elsewhere (p179-strip0.jpg system 1, stanza 4's row), and the header gives no metre for the refrain.
